name: /sdd:pr-msg: writes a PR title and body from a plan

graders.why: a PR message without a title is not a PR message
the plan is about widget reads and the prompt only names the file 'audit-trail', so this shows the plan was read rather than its filename guessed from
the rules forbid an attribution trailer or footer in a PR body
the plan lives in a gitignored spec repo, so naming its path is a dead pointer for a reviewer
